1. (Judgment 1) Tonight reads as a rerun of 2026-10-29. It shares the same layout silhouette (irregular-twelve / vertical / sparse / syncopated / standard / field-dominant / hero-only), the same dark-void/grain ground, and the same mixed/roman/heavy/left type register. Change at least two of those, for example move the figure off the left-aligned sparse column or swap the ground strategy, so a returning visitor doesn't take it for the blueprint night in green.

2. (Judgment 4) The filmstrip skips two zones from the declared `order`. After the signal band it goes straight to the green "The Site" callout and then the footer ticker. Add the work index and the reading-list strip between the signal band and the callout.

3. (Judgment 6) The hero field is a flat mid grey-green slab, not the near-black `#0B130E` void the SHELL declares. No grain is visible on it, so at both widths it reads as a grey box under a black header band. Put the hero on the dark void and make the declared grain visible there.

4. (Judgment 2) The small tracked label "Lions · Week · Final" sits on the bottom of the DETROIT outline strokes at 1440 and touches them at 360. Give it clear space below the ghost word.

5. (Judgment 2) The deck "Detroit 19, their opponent 15 — one score, no cushion." is set small, widely tracked and condensed, in a muted tint on the grey field. The rail's micro labels ("Golf · Mexico Open", "VidantaWorld · Final") have the same problem. Raise their size or move them to the secondary text colour so they can be read.

6. SHELL declares `ground_strategy: dark-void` with `ground_material: grain`. Below the header, the hero field renders as a flat mid-grey slab (about #3D4641) at both 1440 and 360. It reads as a grey box, not the near-black #0B130E void with low grain. Put the grain on the void so the page ground stays near-black from top to bottom.
6. The header is declared `placement: corner`, a cluster with no spanning top bar. Because of the grey field beneath it, the dark area behind the mark and nav reads as a full-width band across the top at 1440. Once the hero field is the same void, the mark and the ruled Work / About / Contact index should stand alone in the top-left corner.
3. The `figure` lead is supposed to span columns 1–8 at poster width, with `DETROIT` as an outline ghost behind and above it. Instead the 19–15 sits in a small bordered card about a quarter of the width wide, and the four-column signal rail takes up as much of the canvas as the hero does. Take the score out of the card and let it run across the eight columns, so the scoreboard number clearly outranks the rail.

1. (Judgment 6) The header declaration says `placement: corner` and "not a top bar." At 1440 the corner cluster sits inside a full-width near-black band that spans the whole top of the page. That band reads as a spanning top bar and starts the hero field well below the top edge. Drop the band so the mark and the ruled Work / About / Contact index float in the top-left corner on the hero ground, with the field running to the top of the viewport.

2. (Judgment 3) The brief sets "Lions win ugly, and I'll take it." as the caption directly under 19–15. On the page, the deck line "Detroit 19, their opponent 15 — one score, no cushion…" sits between the figure and the phrase at both widths, so the eye goes figure, small deck, then h1. Move the deck below the phrase so the reading order is figure, phrase, standfirst.
